import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 100010;
    static final int MAXM = 2000020;
    static final long INF = 1000000000;

    static class Edge {
        int next, to, cap;
        long cost;
        Edge(int next, int to, int cap, long cost) {
            this.next = next;
            this.to = to;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.cost = cost;
        }
    }

    static Edge[] edge = new Edge[MAXM];
    static int[] head = new int[MAXN];
    static int ecnt = 1, node_cnt;
    static List<Integer>[] graph = new List[MAXN];

    static void connect(int u, int v, int cap, long cost) {
        edge[++ecnt] = new Edge(head[u], v, cap, cost);
        head[u] = ecnt;
        edge[++ecnt] = new Edge(head[v], u, 0, -cost);
        head[v] = ecnt;
    }

    static class MinCostFlow {
        static int[] cur = new int[MAXN];
        static boolean[] visited = new boolean[MAXN];
        static long[] dist = new long[MAXN];
        static long[] tag = new long[MAXN];

        static class HeapNode implements Comparable<HeapNode> {
            int id;
            long key;
            HeapNode(int i, long k) {
                id = i;
                key = k;
            }
            @Override
            public int compareTo(HeapNode other) {
                return Long.compare(key, other.key);
            }
        }

        static PriorityQueue<HeapNode> pq = new PriorityQueue<>();

        static boolean dijkstra(int src, int dst) {
            Arrays.fill(dist, 1, node_cnt + 1, INF);
            System.arraycopy(head, 1, cur, 1, node_cnt);
            dist[dst] = 0;
            pq.offer(new HeapNode(dst, 0));

            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                HeapNode node = pq.poll();
                int u = node.id;
                if (visited[u]) continue;
                visited[u] = true;

                for (int i = head[u]; i != 0; i = edge[i].next) {
                    int v = edge[i].to;
                    long w = tag[u] + edge[i ^ 1].cost - tag[v];
                    if (edge[i ^ 1].cap > 0 && dist[u] + w < dist[v]) {
                        dist[v] = dist[u] + w;
                        pq.offer(new HeapNode(v, dist[v]));
                    }
                }
            }

            for (int i = 1; i <= node_cnt; ++i) {
                tag[i] = Math.min(tag[i] + dist[i], INF);
            }

            if (!visited[src]) return false;
            Arrays.fill(visited, 1, node_cnt + 1, false);
            return true;
        }

        static int dfs(int u, int dst, int flow) {
            if (u == dst || flow == 0) return flow;
            int pushed = 0;
            visited[u] = true;

            for (int i = cur[u]; i != 0; i = edge[i].next) {
                cur[u] = i;
                if (edge[i].cap > 0) {
                    int v = edge[i].to;
                    int f;
                    if (!visited[v] && tag[v] + edge[i].cost == tag[u] &&
                        (f = dfs(v, dst, Math.min(flow, edge[i].cap))) > 0) {
                        edge[i].cap -= f;
                        edge[i ^ 1].cap += f;
                        pushed += f;
                        flow -= f;
                        if (flow == 0) break;
                    }
                }
            }

            visited[u] = false;
            return pushed;
        }

        static int max_flow = 0;
        static long min_cost = 0;

        static void compute(int src, int dst) {
            while (dijkstra(src, dst)) {
                int f = dfs(src, dst, Integer.MAX_VALUE);
                max_flow += f;
                min_cost += (long) f * tag[src];
            }
        }
    }

    static int source = 1, sink = 2, n, m, k, c, d;

    static int node_id(int t, int x) {
        return t * n + x + 2;
    }

    static void construct_layer(int t) {
        node_cnt += n;

        for (int u = 1; u <= n; ++u) {
            for (int v : graph[u]) {
                for (int p = 1; p <= k; ++p) {
                    connect(node_id(t, u), node_id(t + 1, v), 1, d * (2L * p - 1));
                }
            }
        }

        for (int u = 1; u <= n; ++u) {
            connect(node_id(t, u), node_id(t + 1, u), Integer.MAX_VALUE, 0);
        }

        connect(node_id(t + 1, 1), sink, Integer.MAX_VALUE, c * (t + 1));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        k = sc.nextInt();
        c = sc.nextInt();
        d = sc.nextInt();
        node_cnt = n + 2;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            graph[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= k; ++i) {
            int a = sc.nextInt();
            connect(source, node_id(0, a), 1, 0);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
            int u = sc.nextInt();
            int v = sc.nextInt();
            graph[u].add(v);
            graph[v].add(u);
        }

        connect(node_id(0, 1), sink, Integer.MAX_VALUE, 0);

        for (int i = 0; i <= n + k; ++i) {
            construct_layer(i);
        }

        MinCostFlow.compute(source, sink);
        System.out.println(MinCostFlow.min_cost);
    }
}
